results.rationale: Forward delivery obligation—our recent road/bridge delivery experience supports a credible commitment to submit a CPM-based 24‑month work program accounting for seasonal/monsoon constraints.

Key staff requirement is only partially evidenced because we have PEC-registered engineers per profile, but the submission evidence does not confirm a PEC-registered Project Manager with 15+ years’ experience nor a Bridge Engineer with 10+ years’ experience.

Company profile evidences an HSE management approach (documented HSE policy and zero reportable fatalities on record), meeting the requirement and aligning with the preferred zero-fatality history expectation.

We can credibly commit to a QC plan based on road construction experience, but there is no explicit evidence of owning/providing on-site laboratory facilities for soils/aggregates/concrete/asphalt testing.
Procedural commitment—complied with in the submission (sealed envelope, single stage one envelope, addressed to the specified office under KPPRA 2014).
